title: Fade of 1h swing highs and lows, with and without a 4h or daily swing nearby, against random levels

what.name: Idea
what.value_plain: A 1h swing high or low that lines up with a 4h or daily swing is a stronger level, so fading it should do better than a plain 1h swing.
what.label: OURS

what.name: Swing
what.value_plain: Williams 5-bar swing on 1h, 4h and daily BTCUSDT bars; a level lives 96 hours
what.label: OURS

what.name: Confluence
what.value_plain: A 4h or daily swing (last 5 of that kind) within 0.5 ATR of the 1h level
what.label: OURS

what.name: Entry
what.value_plain: Fade at first touch of the level (touch = fill at the level, or the open if gapped; optimistic for a fade)
what.label: OURS

what.name: Stop / target / time exit
what.value_plain: Stop 1 ATR beyond the level, target +1 R, exit after 24 hours
what.label: OURS

what.name: Control
what.value_plain: Random levels drawn from the same distance distribution, 2 per real event
what.label: OURS

what.name: Fees
what.value_plain: Taker on both legs, 0.05 % per side (about 0.17 R per trade at a 1 ATR stop); no slippage
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Test
what.value_plain: Real minus random, week-block bootstrap 95 % CI; shift null over the labels; a planted +0.3 % edge must be found
what.label: OURS

how: Every touch of a live 1h swing level inside DEV is replayed minute by minute on the rule above, and the same is done for random levels at matched distance. Groups: no confluence, 4h confluence, daily confluence. All parameters frozen in PRE_REG.md before the first run.
window: DEV 2022-01-01 to 2025-06-30 (files after 2025-06 never opened; HOLDOUT untouched)

verdict.label: FAIL: confluence levels lose more than random levels, fee-net

why: Confluence: n = 2556, net -0.267 R per trade; random levels -0.160 R; real minus random -0.106 R (CI -0.143 to -0.070).
No-confluence swings also lose (-0.226 R) and also trail their random control (-0.137 R).
Before fees the rule is slightly negative too (stop 3,908 vs target 3,446 of 7,416 trades), so it is not only fees.
n is far above the 551 needed to see 0.10 %, so this is not a thin-data null. Price tends to run through these levels, not respect them.
Other tolerance, stop, target or horizon values are untested. Trading the opposite way is a new trial. No rule added.
